QuestInfo.name: Donating to Kerning City
QuestInfo.0: #p425#, the City Clerk, seems to be looking for items needed to manage #m10003000#. Let's go see #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, requested a donation of #b30 #t4000034#s#k for #m10003000#. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 42 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I gathered the items requested by #p425#, the City Clerk, and brought them to her. I'm glad I could contribute to the development of our town.

0.0: "We are looking for someone to donate #b30 #t4000034#s#k for the sake of #m10003000#. We will give a small gift prepared by the city to the resident who contributes.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: Hello there, #h0#. What brings you here today? Ah, you're saying you'd like to donate #b30 #t4000034##k for the city. Heh!

yes.0: Thank you so much! I've officially received the #b30 #t4000034##k. By the way, you're wondering what these items will be used for? Heh... Wouldn't it be better for you not to try and know too much? Anyway, I'll count on you next time as well!

item.0: Welcome, #h0#. So, you're interested in donating to the town? If that's the case, just collect #b30 #t4000034##k and bring them to me. I'll be counting on you!

level.0: Could you please speak to me again after you reach Level 42 or higher?
